programme.title: Brahms - Double Concerto in A minor, Op. 102
programme.desc: The 2007 Europa-Konzert takes place in Berlin, on the occasion of the 125th anniversary of the Berliner Philharmoniker. Under the theme "The Year 1882", the acclaimed orchestra interprets works of Brahms and Wagner under the baton of Sir Simon Rattle. The soloists are Lisa Batiashvili (violin) and Truls Mørk (cello). The 2007 Europa-Konzert takes place in Berlin, on the occasion of the 125th anniversary of the Berliner Philharmoniker. Under the theme "The Year 1882", the acclaimed orchestra is lead by conductor Sir Simon Rattle as it interprets Brahms’ Concerto for violin, cello and orchestra, his Fourth Symphony and Wagners’ Prelude to Act I from Parsifal - the piece that marked the orchestra's first recorded work of September 1913 under the baton of Alfred Hertz. The soloists are Lisa Batiashvili (violin) and Truls Mørk (cello), established as sought-after young virtuosos and appearing regularly with leading orchestras and in recitals throughout the world. The Kraftwerk und Kabelwerk Oberspree (power and cable factory), the remarkable venue of this concert, is one of the most impressive historical industrial building from the late 19th century in Berlin. As its impressive presence is infused with Brahms and Wagner, there is an air of total commitment, only enhanced further by the unusual surroundings. The collaboration of Lisa Batiashvili and Truls Mørk ensures a moving performance of Brahms’s last orchestral work, his Double Concerto. Following this, Rattle and the orchestra continue to demonstrate their outstanding musicianship, delivering Wagner's amazingly fresh and dynamic Fourth Symphony.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Sonata No. 31, Op. 110
programme.desc: Tom Beghin’s new recording of Beethoven’s Piano Sonatas Opus 109, 110, and 111 is an artistic exploration of how Beethoven’s musicking was shaped by the work environment he created with the help of colleagues and friends. Not only does pianist Tom Beghin perform Beethoven’s trilogy of pianistic masterpieces on a magnificent new replica of Beethoven’s Broadwood piano, he uses a reconstruction of the Gehörmaschine that was mounted on the composer’s piano so he could continue to create music as his hearing declined.

programme.title: Mozart - Ave Verum Corpus, K. 618
programme.desc: Since its founding over 500 years ago the Wiener Sängerknaben, also known as the Vienna Boys' Choir, has been a fixed attraction in musical life. The Radio Symphonieorchester Wien plays under the baton of Bertrand de Billy; soloist is the French soprano Sandrine Piau. Since its founding over 500 years ago the Wiener Sängerknaben, also known as the Vienna Boys' Choir, has been a fixed attraction in musical life. A number of important musicians have been connected with the famous choir. Joseph Haydn and Franz Schubert, for example, have been members themselves. Not to forget about W. A. Mozart, who composed several musical works for the choir. On January 27, 2006 - the day of the composer’s 250th anniversary - the Wiener Sängerknaben celebrated Mozart with this concert from the Stephansdom in Vienna. The Radio Symphonieorchester Wien plays under the baton of Bertrand de Billy; soloist is the French soprano Sandrine Piau.

programme.title: Rolando Villazón - One Night in Berlin
programme.desc: French-Mexican tenor Rolando Villazón (1972) is among the most versatile artists alive today. He is accompanied by the Südwestdeutsche Kammerphilharmonie Konstanz in performing a colourful recital from the Berliner Philharmonie. French-Mexican tenor Rolando Villazón (1972) is accompanied by the Südwestdeutsche Kammerphilharmonie Konstanz in performing a colourful recital from the Berliner Philharmonie. In this concert from 2006, Villazón performs various arias by Italian opera composers like Verdi, Rossini, Donizetti, Cilea and Mascagni. On the program are also some French works by Massenet, like Ô Souverain, ô juge, ô père from Le Cid and Toute mon âme est là! Pourquoi me réveiller, ô souffle du printemp from ‘Werther’. Through his uniquely compelling performances with leading opera houses and orchestras around the world, Villazón established himself as one of the music world’s most beloved stars and one of the leading tenors of our day. The Times heralded him as the most charming of today’s divos.

programme.title: Prokofiev - Excerpts from Romeo & Julia, Op. 64
programme.desc: The beautiful Mariinsky Theatre in St. Petersburg formed the background for the 1996 edition of the annual Europe Concert of the Berliner Philharmoniker. In honour of the Russian hosts works by Prokofiev and Rachmaninov. The beautiful Mariinsky Theatre in St. Petersburg formed the background for the 1996 edition of the annual Europakonzert of the Berliner Philharmoniker. In honour of the Russian hosts, the concert opened with highlights from Prokofiev's 'Romeo and Juliet', followed by the Cavatina from Rachmaninoff's opera 'Aleko'. After the intermission, Kolja Blacher featured in the two 'Violin Romances' by Beethoven, followed by a performance of his 'Seventh Symphony'. The orchestra is led by maestro Claudio Abbado.

programme.title: Handel Celebration
programme.desc: This outstanding British-German performance in Handel’s baptistery, the Market Church in Halle, represents the media highlight of the Handel Year 2009. The 250th anniversary of George Frederic Handel’s death takes place on April 14th, 2009. On this momentous occasion, two of the world’s leading baroque orchestras and conductor Howard Arman honour the composer by playing the repertoire of the historic Handel Commemoration Concert which took place in London’s Westminster Abbey 25 years after Handel’s death. This outstanding British-German performance in Handel’s baptistery, the Market Church in Halle, represents the media highlight of the Handel Year 2009.

programme.title: CMIM Piano 2024 - Semi-final I: Anthony Ratinov
programme.desc: Pianist Anthony Ratinov (USA, 1997) joins the CMIM ensemble, consisting of three principal strings players of the Montreal Symphony Orchestra, in a performance of the first movement, Sostenuto assai - Allegro ma non troppo, of Robert Schumann’s Piano Quartet in E-flat major, Op. 47. This performance took place during the chamber music round of the two-part semi-final of the Piano Edition of the Concours musical international de Montréal 2024 (CMIM). It was recorded at the Bourgie Hall of the Montreal Museum of Fine Arts.

programme.title: The Boy with the Wig: Kids on Mozart
programme.desc: In this 30-minute film, children have their say; boys and girls aged between eight and eleven recount Mozart's life in their own words. Discover Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart through the eyes of children. The Boy with the Wig - Kids on Mozart explores children’s fascination with the composer. The 30-minute film by Claus Wischmann features boys and girls aged between eight and eleven recounting his life through humour and serious interpretations of Mozart’s biography. Discover Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart through the eyes of children.

programme.title: Schubert - Rondo D. 951
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored chamber music repertoire in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Lily Maisky and Iddo Bar-Shaï, violinists Tedi Papavrami and Akiko Suwanai, her daughter Lyda Chen-Argerich on viola, and cellist Mischa Maisky. On the program are Felix Mendelssohn’s Piano Trio No. 1 in D minor, Op. 49; Leoš Janáček’s Violin Sonata; Franz Schubert’s Rondo in A major, D. 951; and Johannes Brahms’s Piano Quartet No. 3 in C minor, Op. 60. These performances were recorded on May 4 and June 13, 2021.

programme.title: Mussorgsky - Pictures at an Exhibition - X
programme.desc: American conductor Leonard Slatkin leads the Orchestre National de Lyon in a concert recorded at the Auditorium de Lyon in 2014. The concert opens with William Bolcom´s Circus Ouverture, which was specially composed for Slatkin's 70th birthday. The concert continues with a performance of Beethoven's Triple Concerto in C, Op. 56 American conductor Leonard Slatkin leads the Orchestre National de Lyon in a concert recorded at the Auditorium de Lyon in 2014. The concert opens with William Bolcom´s Circus Ouverture, which was specially composed for Slatkin's 70th birthday. The concert continues with a performance of Beethoven's Triple Concerto in C, Op. 56 performed by three female soloists: Olga Kern (piano), Baibe Skride (violin) and Sol Gabetta (cello). The work is the only concerto which Beethoven ever completed for more than one solo instrument. The concert closes with Ravel's beloved orchestration of Mussorgsky's Pictures at an Exhibition.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartets Nos. 1, 9 & 10
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music. This program features Quatuor Ébène performing Beethoven’s String Quartet No. 1 in F major, Op. 18, No. 1; String Quartet No. 10 in E-flat major, Op. 74, "Harp"; and String Quartet No. 9 in C major, Op. 59, No. 3, "Razumovsky". This concert performance was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris on October 13, 2020.

programme.title: Summertime at the Domaine Forget
programme.desc: The documentary Summertime at the Domaine Forget introduces internationally renowned treasure: Domaine Forget festival in Saint-Irénée, Québec. The documentary Summertime at the Domaine Forget introduces internationally renowned treasure: Domaine Forget festival in Saint-Irénée, Québec. programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartet No. 4, Op. 18, No. 4
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music. This program features Quatuor Ébène performing Beethoven’s String Quartet No. 5 in A major, Op. 18, No. 5; String Quartet No. 4 in C minor, Op. 18, No. 4; and String Quartet No. 12 in E-flat major, Op. 127. This concert was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris on December 17, 2020.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 3
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 present Bach’s Brandenburg Concerto No. 3 in G major, BWV 1048. J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021. The concertos are based on the Italian concerto grosso form, in which a group of solo instruments is set against a large ensemble. Bach’s Brandenburg Concertos feature remarkable combinations of solo instruments and virtuoso solos. In this performance at the Hall of Mirrors in the Köthen Castle, Germany, Luks and his Collegium 1704 present Bach’s Brandenburg Concerto No. 3 in G major, BWV 1048. This concerto was composed for three violins, three violas, three cellos, and basso continuo. Remarkable is the concerto’s form: the two fast movements are separated by an Adagio consisting of a single measure of just two chords.

programme.desc: After more than thirty years at the top Ensemble Daedalus is saying goodbye to the concert stage. That demands a fitting farewell. With Italian carnival songs and morescas by Renaissance composers such as Barbetta, Banchieri, and Falconieri, this farewell will be above all a party, with - true to tradition - first-rate performers, such as his traveling companion Marco Beasley. programme.title: Mozart Symphony No. 34 & Dvořák Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: Maestro Iván Fischer leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a remarkable concert program featuring Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Symphony No. 34 in C major, K. 338, and Antonín Dvořák’s Symphony No. 7 in D minor, Op. 70. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, on January 29, 2021. Maestro Iván Fischer leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a remarkable concert program of works by Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart and Antonín Dvořák. Mozart’s Symphony No. 34 in C major, K. 338 opens the program. Completed in the summer of 1780, this was the last symphony Mozart wrote in Salzburg, where he worked as a court musician. The three-movement symphony features two vibrant outer movements with fanfares and rousing themes, while the quieter second movement is scored for strings alone, deviating from the typical four-movement structure of the time. Next on the program is Dvořák’s Symphony No. 7 in D minor, Op. 70, completed in March 1885 and premiered one month later in London conducted by the composer himself. With its dramatic and dark style, this symphony stands in stark contrast to the predominantly optimistic tone of Dvořák’s broader oeuvre. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, on January 29, 2021.

programme.title: Bruckner - Symphony No. 4
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra in a performance of the first edition (1) of Anton Bruckner’s (1824-1896) Symphony No. 4, called the Romantic by its creator. The Cleveland Orchestra, called the most European of America’s prestige formations, has been setting new standards in Bruckner interpretation for several years now through the expertise of Welser-Möst. When it comes to shaping a musical event for the ears and the eyes, the monumental majesty of Anton Bruckner’s (1824-1896) symphonies and the exhilarating vibrancy of St. Florian’s monastery are a perfect match - especially when they are captured on film so thrillingly by such an eminent director as Brian Large in 2012. Bruckner became acquainted with the monastery’s organ in his childhood and served as the organist there from 1845 to 1855. Welser-Möst, the principal conductor of the Cleveland Orchestra and General Music Director of the Vienna State Opera, is an acknowledged Bruckner specialist who has developed a passion for the composer’s Fourth Symphony - called the Romantic by its creator - in its infrequently played first edition (1888/89). More slender, dynamic and finely shaded than the more commonly performed version, this score is also more daring, with its sharper contrasts and boldly exposed dissonances. Recorded at the St. Florian Monastery in Austria, in 2012.

programme.title: Fantasymphony - A Concert of Fire and Magic
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra once again opens the gates to magical worlds with an enchanting concert program. Under the baton of German conductor Christian Schumann, the Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Danish National Concert Choir, and Danish National Junior Choir team up to perform music from the most popular fantasy movies, TV series and video games, including The Lord of The Rings, Game of Thrones, The Hobbit, The Witcher, and League of Legends. Featured soloists in this concert are Norwegian mezzo-soprano Tuva Semmingsen, Canadian-Portuguese soprano Cassandra Lemoine, Danish musician Bjørn Fjæstad, and British actor David Bateson.

programme.title: CMIM Piano 2024 - Semi-final I: Arisa Onoda
programme.desc: Pianist Arisa Onoda (Japan, 1996) joins the CMIM ensemble in a performance of the first movement, Allegro molto moderato, of Gabriel Fauré’s Piano Quartet No. 1 in C minor, Op. 15. This performance took place during the chamber music round of the two-part semi-final of the Piano Edition of the Concours musical international de Montréal 2024 (CMIM). programme.title: Discovering Masterpieces - Brandenburg Concertos
programme.desc: This episode of Discovering Masterpieces presents the Brandenburg Concertos by Johann Sebastian Bach (1685-1750). Musical excerpts played by the Freiburger Barockorchester conducted by Gottfried von der Goltz. This episode presents the Brandenburg Concertos by Johann Sebastian Bach (1685-1750). Musical excerpts played by the Freiburger Barockorchester conducted by Gottfried von der Goltz. Bach's six Brandenburg Concertos rank among the undisputed favorites of all baroque fans. They have become a firm fixture in music education and an integral part of our international musical heritage. So what's their secret? The internationally acclaimed pianist and Bach expert Robert Levin provides an answer.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 4
programme.desc: Together with the world's leading youth orchestra - the Gustav Mahler Jugendorchester (GMJO) - Abbado performs Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 4 and Arnold Schönberg’s Pelleas et Melisande, Op.5. Recorded 2006 at Musikverein Vienna. The program is introduced with a short documentation about Schönberg's Pelleas et Melisande, based on a text by Claudio Abbado. Every musical theme relates to a special colour appearing on screen. What has been so remarkable about Abbado’s Mahler performances is that their impact has never been achieved at the expense of the multiple sensitivities, subtleties and extreme sophistication. Together with the world's leading youth orchestra - the Gustav Mahler Jugendorchester (GMJO) - Abbado performs Mahler’s Symphony No. 4 and Schönberg’s Pelleas und Melisande, Op. 5. The Gustav Mahler Jugendorchester was founded in Vienna in 1986, by Abbado’s initiative. The orchestra's high level of artistic quality and its international success have moved important conductors and soloists to work with the ensemble.

programme.title: Liszt Mosaics- II
programme.desc: This dance concert - performed in the languages of both music and movement - features, in addition to works by Liszt, some of the finest pieces of Hungary's national romanticism that served to inspire them, antecedents of sacred music reaching as far back as the Gregorian period and compositions by contemporaries who influenced Liszt: Paganini and Chopin. This dance concert - performed in the languages of both music and movement - features, in addition to works by Liszt, some of the finest pieces of Hungary's national romanticism that served to inspire them, antecedents of sacred music reaching as far back as the Gregorian period and compositions by contemporaries who influenced Liszt: Paganini and Chopin. Liszt Mosaics is founded on three thematic pillars. Although all three directly evoke Liszt - with emblematic aspects of his life's work: Liszt the Hungarian, Liszt the priest and Liszt the virtuoso - they speak at least as much to us as people of the 21st century. The Hungarian State Folk Ensemble was established in 1951 and has traveled to over 40 countries, playing authentic folk music and folk dances.

programme.title: Holst - The Planets
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam and the Nationaal Vrouwen Jeugdkoor in a performance of Gustav Holst’s The Planets, Op. 32, recorded at De Doelen, Rotterdam, in 2019. Van Alphen founded Sinfonia Rotterdam in 2000. Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam and the Nationaal Vrouwen Jeugdkoor in a performance of Gustav Holst’s The Planets, Op. 32, recorded at De Doelen, Rotterdam, in 2019. Van Alphen founded Sinfonia Rotterdam in 2000. Under his passionate leadership, this orchestra has developed into one of the Netherland’s best-known orchestras. Holst worked on his orchestral suite The Planets, as an expression of his interest in astrology, from 1914 to 1916. The Planets consists of seven movements, each one named after the planet known at that time (excluding Earth), and its corresponding astrological character: Mars: the Bringer of War, Venus: the Bringer of Peace, Mercury: the Winged Messenger, Jupiter: the Bringer of Jollity, Saturn: the Bringer of Old Age, Uranus: the Magician, and Neptune: the Mystic. The middle section of Jupiter features a glorious melody that has become widely known. Holst adapted this melody when he set the poem I Vow to thee to thy Country to music. The last movement of The Planets includes a women’s choir, lending the music its mysterious, celestial atmosphere.

programme.title: Rachmaninov - Suite No. 1, Op. 5 - II. The Night …
programme.desc: In this splendid concert, exceptional Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a program for two pianos comprising works of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Maurice Ravel, Anton Arensky, Sergei Rachmaninoff, and Nikolai Kapustin. Both pianists, laureates of the prestigious International Tchaikovsky Competition in 1994, have received international recognition. This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on November 25, 2021. In this splendid concert, exceptional Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a program for two pianos comprising works of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Maurice Ravel, Anton Arensky, Sergei Rachmaninoff, and Nikolai Kapustin. Both pianists, laureates of the prestigious International Tchaikovsky Competition in 1994, have received international recognition. They perform regularly in a duo. On the program: Mozart’s Sonata for two pianos in D major, K. 448/375 A; Ravel’s La Valse (arr. for two pianos); Arensky’s Suite No. 1 for two pianos, Op. 15; and Rachmaninoff’s Suite No. 1 (Fantasy) for two pianos, Op. 5. As an encore, the duo performs ‘Romance’ from Rachmaninoff’s Suite No. 2 for two pianos, Op. 17, followed by ‘Overture’ from Nikolai Kapustin’s Sinfonietta, Op. 49. This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on November 25, 2021.

programme.title: Gluck - Iphigénie en Tauride
programme.desc: IIphigénie en Tauride (1779) is a four-act tragic opera by German-born composer Christoph Willibald Gluck. Diego Fasolis conducts the Orchestre National des Pays de la Loire and the Chœur d’Angers Nantes Opéra in this production. Among the soloists are Marie-Adeline Henry (Iphigénie), Charles Rice (Oreste), Sébastien Droy (Pylade), Jean-Luc Ballestra (Thoas), and Élodie Hache (Diane). This performance was recorded at the Grand Théâtre d’Angers, France, in 2020. Iphigénie en Tauride (1779) is a four-act tragic opera by German-born composer Christoph Willibald Gluck. Written for the French stage, the work’s premiere in 1779 at the Parisian Royal Academy of Music was a great success. Iphigénie en Tauride is one of the composer’s ‘reform operas’, meaning that the music was to follow the drama and its expression. Nicolas-François Guillard’s libretto is based on Claude Guimond de La Touche’s play of the same name, but ultimately it derives from Euripides’s famous ancient Greek drama. Set shortly after the Trojan War, Iphigénie, who was to be sacrificed by her father Agamemnon, is saved and carried off by the goddess Diana to Tauris, where Iphigénie becomes Diana’s high priestess. Diego Fasolis conducts the Orchestre National des Pays de la Loire and the Chœur d’Angers Nantes Opéra in this production. Among the soloists are Marie-Adeline Henry (Iphigénie), Charles Rice (Oreste), Sébastien Droy (Pylade), Jean-Luc Ballestra (Thoas), and Élodie Hache (Diane). This performance was recorded at the Grand Théâtre d’Angers, France, in 2020.

programme.title: Waldbühne Concert 1992: French Night
programme.desc: The Berlin Philharmonic, conducted by Georges Prêtre, performs a French program during the Waldbühne Concert of 1992. Leon Fleisher is the soloist in Ravel’s Piano Concerto for the Left Hand. The program includes works by Debussy, Ravel and Offenbach. The Berlin Philharmonic, conducted by Georges Prêtre (1924-2017), performs a French program during the Waldbühne Concert of 1992. The Waldbühne in Berlin is one of the most attractive outdoor amphitheatres in Europe and home to the Berliner Philharmoniker's summer concerts. With a 20,000 seat capacity, these events are some of the most popular classical music concerts in the world. This year’s concert opens with Hector Berlioz’ Roman Carnival Overture followed by a performance of Maurice Ravel’s Piano Concerto for the Left Hand starring soloist Leon Fleisher. The program also features Debussy’s L'Après-Midi d’un Faune, Bizet’s Carmen Suite and Ravel’s famous Bolero. After some lively dance music by Bizet and Offenbach, the orchestra concludes with Strauss’ Radetzky March and Lincke’s Berliner Luft, a whistle-along favourite which produces some entertaining audience reaction.

programme.title: Barbapapa
programme.desc: Crtana serija "Barbapapa" fokusira se na svakodnevne živote članova obitelji Barbapapa, bića koja mijenjaju oblik. Epizode uključuju avanture obitelji koja se upušta u neobične i često duhovite situacije, kao što je izgradnja rakete za Mars ili djeca koja pokušavaju od roditelja sakriti slona kojeg su pronašli u divljini, a iz svega toga likovi dobivaju novu, životnu pouku.

programme.title: Bibin čarobni svijet
programme.desc: 'Bibin čarobni svijet' je čudnovati animirani svijet za djecu predškolske dobi, koja kroz zabavne nastavke otkrivaju prirodu, uče kako se lijepo ponašati i stvaraju zdrave navike. U uzbudljivim pustolovinama, Bibi i njezino društvo, koje čine znatiželjni prijatelj Bobby i njihovi izvanzemaljski prijatelji Zazzy i Zina, istražuju začaranu šumu, rješavaju misterije i uče važne životne pouke.

programme.desc: Animirani serijal prati pustolovine simpatične djevojčice Maše i Medvjeda, koji postanu prijatelji. programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Zexal
programme.desc: Kada ambiciozni duelist Yuma upozna Astral, tajanstvenog posjetitelja iz drugog svemira, čini se kao sudbina. Yuma treba Astrala da ga nauči kako da se dvoboji, a Astral treba Yumu da mu pomogne povratiti sjećanja! Oni bi bili najveći tag tim dvoboja... osim što se ne slažu! Ovaj duel bolje da se brzo spoji jer ZEXAL je potpuno novi dvoboj s većim izazovima nego ikad prije! Fantastična nova čudovišta! Snažne nove karte! Tehnologija dvoboja s proširenom stvarnošću! Zajedno, dvoboj ide na sljedeću razinu! Ali ne brinite ako nikada prije niste bili u dvoboju: Dok Astral prolazi Yumom kroz osnove, novi gledatelji mogu pratiti i naučiti kako se natjecati. A za iskusne profesionalce, postoji mnogo nikad viđenih strategija koje se mogu koristiti u stvarnom životu! Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL - Nova pravila, novi dvoboji!

programme.title: Bibin čarobni svijet
programme.desc: 'Bibin čarobni svijet' je čudnovati animirani svijet za djecu predškolske dobi, koja kroz zabavne nastavke otkrivaju prirodu, uče kako se lijepo ponašati i stvaraju zdrave navike. U uzbudljivim pustolovinama, Bibi i njezino društvo, koje čine znatiželjni prijatelj Bobby i njihovi izvanzemaljski prijatelji Zazzy i Zina, istražuju začaranu šumu, rješavaju misterije i uče važne životne pouke.

programme.title: Novo jutro
programme.desc: Milionski auditorijum sa teritorije cele Srbije, svih starosnih i socijalnih kategorija svoj dan počinje uz "Novo jutro". Pored najpopularnijih voditeljskih tandema, gledaoci tokom cele radnje nedelje ostaju uz naše jutro zahvaljujući pravovremenom i aktuelnom izveštavanju kroz neizostavne rubrike: "Prelistavanje dnevne štampe", "Tema jutra", "(Ne)zapaženo" i mnoge druge. Zaštitni znak "Novog jutra" su i uključenja iz cele Srbije, ali i Beograda zahvaljujući autentičnom Filipu Maksimoviću i uvek nasmejanom Milanu Raoniću, uz koje ćemo i ovu sezonu početi u vrhu top liste gledanosti.

programme.title: Nasledstvo
programme.desc: Dve žene koje se nikada u životu nisu srele otrovane su istim otrovom, istoga dana. Jedna je devedesetogodišnja vlasnica predratnog hotela Pariz u kojem je vreme stalo, a druga je sekretarica tajkuna koji pokušava da se domogne hotela u centru grada, kako bi na njegovom mestu izgradio najveći tržni centar na Balkanu. Ko je ubica dve žene, a ko neverovatni naslednik hotela i celokupne imovine ubijene vlasnice? U mnogobrojnim obrtima, u vrtlogu para i ljubavi, odanosti i izdaje, iskrenosti i podlosti, sveta siromašnih i sveta bogatih, poštenja i lopovluka, časti i pohlepe, skromnosti i snobovštine, sukoba generacija, porodičnih lomova i društvenih previranja - lome se i sudbine čak i onih koji u tome nisu želeli da učestvuju.

programme.title: Premijera
programme.desc: Aktuelno, premijerno, za korak ispred svih - Premijera je zbog toga najgledanija kratka forma vesti o poznatima. Ne postoji javna ličnost do koje premijerna ekipa ne može doći, a nijedan gradski događaj ne može proći bez njih. I u novoj sezoni najveće domaće i regionalne zvezde govoriće pred Premijerinim kamerama, ali kroz nove rubrike: Ličnost dana, VIP online, Sa beogradskih ulica i Ispred premijernog objektiva.

programme.title: Ekskluzivno
programme.desc: Za razliku od većine sličnih formata, ekipa emisije Ekskluzivno ima drugačiji pristup poznatim ličnostima. Direktno i bez uvijanja, sva ona pitanja koja drugi ne smeju da pitaju, postavljaju novinari emisije Ekskluzivno i donose priče o poznatima iz drugog ugla.

programme.title: Oteta, serija
programme.desc: Priča o Orhunu, koji želi da osveti svoju sestru, i Hiri, koja je zarobljenica svoje savesti... Orhun je uspešan biznismen koji je odrastao u bogatoj porodici bez ljubavi zajedno sa svojom sestrom bliznakinjom Nihan, mlađom sestrom Nursah i njihovom hladnom, udaljenom majkom Afife. Nihan je otišla da volonterski radi kao lekar u Eritreji, ali je odnedavno bilo nemoguće kontaktirati, a njena porodica je zabrinuta za nju. Dok traži svoju sestru, nailazi na Hiru, siromašnu devojku koja živi kao zatvorenik u rukama trgovaca ljudima. Kada saznaju da je Nihan otrovala i ubila lokalna banda, Orhun se slomi. Kada se ispostavi da je Hira zapravo bila ta koja je otrovala njegovu sestru, Orhun kuje zli plan osvete: povest će Hiru kući sa sobom i učiniti joj još gore. U međuvremenu, Afife, njihova majka, tajno je držala Orhunovog oca podalje od njegovog detinjstva. Orhun odlučuje da se oženi Hirom iz osvete. Afife mrzi ljude nižeg statusa i opsednuta je "čistom krvlju". Hoće li ovaj brak zatvoriti Afife, ili će par pronaći iskupljenje nakon što plati sve svoje obaveze?

programme.title: Klopka ljubavi, serija
programme.desc: Mračna kletva „visi nad bogatom porodicom Develioglu. Njen naslednik mora da je dečak, ali za Džihana, naslednik porodične imperije, deca su samo neostvarena želja. On u ljubav ne veruje. Sklopio je brak po dogovoru i smatra da je prosto nemoguće biti uspešan i u poslovanju i u ljubavi. Ljubav je za njega slabost. Njegova majka Mukader, nemilosrdni čuvar porodične tradicije i budućnosti, spremna je na sve da obezbedi svom sinu naslednika. Ona nudi Bejzi, Džihanovoj neplodnoj ženi, opasan dogovor: razvod za Džihanino potomstvo, uz obećanje da će se vratiti nakon rođenja njegovog sina. Inače Bejza je takođe iz imućne turske porodice.Sa druge strane, u siromašnoj četvrti Istanbula, živi mlada Hančer koja se bori sa životom u siromaštvu. Živi sa bolesnim bratom, njegovom ženom i bratancem. Hančer dobija ponudu koja će promeniti njenu sudbinu: brak sa Džihanom. Naravno uslov je da je plodna i poslušna, kao i da pristane na brak bez emocija. Iako njeno srce traži pravu ljubav, bolesni brat je tera na žrtvu.Džihan i Hančer nisu ni svesni da prave nepovratni korak. Život će im se ispuniti intrigama i tajnama, ništa više neće biti isto. Džihanova bivša žena Bejza neće nestati iz njihovih života. Oštra i moćna Mukader će uraditi sve da brak bude samo dogovor i da se posle rođenja naslednika reši Hančer. Hančer samo sanja da pomogne svojoj nesrećnoj porodici, dok Džihan traži ženu isključivo zbog naslednika.Hoće li ljubav ipak pronaći put u svetu gde svako teži želji za bolje?

programme.title: Odbačena, serija
programme.desc: Reč je o životnoj avanturi devojčice po imenu Melisa Celik, koja je kao beba ostala bez roditelja, a koja je ostala u sirotištu. Niko ne zna istinu o tome šta se desilo njenoj porodici. Melisa pokušava da ostane sa porodicom koja ju je usvojila, ali Besime, domaćica, ne želi Melisu i podvrgava je raznim mučenjima. Jednog dana, kada je kao žrtvu gneva stave na vrata, pred njom se pojavljuje muškarac, Metin. Tada počinju da pričaju, nesvesni da će im se život od tog trenutka potpuno promeniti.

programme.title: Vjetrovi ljubavi, serija
programme.desc: Zejnep je oličenje gracioznosti i inteligencije, kojoj se svi dive. Ipak, ona ima skriveni ratnički duh. Halil, mlad bez roditelja i opterećen tugom, suočio se sa životnim nedaćama. Njihovi putevi se prepliću - Zejnep, slobodnog duha ispod svoje staložene spoljašnjosti, i Halil, odan porodici. Zajedno u vrtlogu ljubavi, oni nalaze da su njihove sudbine neraskidivo povezane. Dok se kreću putem prepunom izbora i posledica, ostaje pitanje: može li njihova ljubav izdržati izazove sa kojima se suočavaju?

programme.title: Idi mi, dođi mi, film
programme.desc: Mladi bračni par, Marija (Rialda Kadrić) i Boba (Vladimir Petrović) useljavaju u svoj novi stan i kreću u novi život. No uskoro počinju zapostavljati jedno drugo i dijete te život podređuju materijalnim stvarima. Život im ne olakšavaju niti djedovi Žika (Dragomir Bojanić Gidra) i Milan (Marko Todorović) koji se uporno miješaju u njihove privatne stvari. Srećom, Marija i Boba će vrlo brzo shvatiti da im je najveća vrijednost obitelj, kao i međusobna bliskost i ljubav. Popularni filmski serijal s područja bivše Jugoslavije, „Lude godine, započeo je svoje prikazivanje davne 1977., a slijedilo je još devet nastavaka do 1992. Sve od reda režirao ih je Zoran Čalić, a sedmi nastavak, snimljen 1985., dobio je naziv „Žikina dinastija. Iako u originalu zamišljena kao ozbiljna drama koja upozorava na društvene probleme poput seksa bez zaštite i tinejdžerske trudnoće, sporedni likovi Živorad "Žika" Pavlović (Dragomir Bojanić Gidra) te Milan Todorović (Marko Todorović) istaknuli su svoj talent za komediju te ubrzo preuzeli glavnu riječ. Iako ga filmska struka nije prihvatila, serijal je postao jedan od najpopularnijih u Jugoslaviji, pa čak i u zemljama Istočne Europe. Tako je glumica Rialda Kadrić primila pozivnicu Moskovskog filmskog festivala, koji je tada bio isključivo rezerviran za nove zvijezde Sovjetskog Saveza. Serija se pokazala odličnom odskočnom daskom mnogim budućim zvijezdama bivše Jugoslavije - Sonji Savić, Zoranu Cvijanoviću, Nikoli Koji, Gali Videnović i Branku Đuriću. Naziv serije osmišljen je kao parodija na popularnu američku seriju „Dinastija, koja je sredinom 80-ih osvojila gledatelje s područja tadašnje Jugoslavije.

programme.title: Seljaci, serija
programme.desc: Serija "Seljaci" je saga o nekoliko seoskih porodica koje žive u našem selu Treskavica, a čiji su mnogi članovi rasuti po svetu od Pariza do Novog Zelanda. Dolazi do mešanja starih i novih običaja i navika, što je izvor mnogih konfliktnih i komičnih situacija. Zašto gledaoci vole da gledaju seriju "Seljaci"? Zato što je autentična, naša, što sa blagom ironijom i humorom govori o našim manama i lošim navikama, a sa velikom simpatijom o našim tradicionalnim vrednostima...

programme.title: Ljubav navika panika, serija
programme.desc: Brak je kada dvoje ljudi zajedno rešavaju probleme koje nikad ne bi imali da nisu zajedno...oni se stalno svađaju, ali ne bi valjalo da je drugačije...oni su razdvojeni, ali žive u istom stanu... oni su srećni u svađama, neverovatni u neurozi i nemoćni da smisle argument za svoje ili tuđe ponašanje... kada ljubav postane navika da li sve postaje panika.....

programme.title: Trenutak iz sna
programme.desc: Nova sezona „Trenutak iz sna donosi priče žena čiji fizički izgled svedoči o decenijama stresa, tuge, teškog fizičkog rada i trauma. Njihov fizički izgled odražava godine skrivanja od pogleda drugih iz straha da ne budu osuđene, a svaki pogled u ogledalo ih podseća na njihove unutrašnje borbe, svaki susret sa ljudima ih suočava sa osećajem srama i odbačenosti. Kroz suze, bol i odlučnost pronašle su put ka svetlu. Njihove priče su izuzetne, njihova hrabrost nadmašuje granice mogućeg, a njihova transformacija je inspiracija za sve. Tim vrhunskih stručnjaka učiniće sve da ove žene podignu iz pepela, obnove njihovu veru u sebe i pronađu unutrašnju snagu. Hirurzi i anti-aging eksperti kombinovali su svoje svoje veštine kako bi obnovili, pomladili kožu i uklonili mnoge fizičke nedostatke, pomažući ženama da povrate svežinu i vitalnost. Stomatolozi stvaraju blistav osmeh koji zrači samopouzdanjem i zdravljem. Psiholozi pružaju emocionalnu podršku i pomažu ženama da prevaziđu unutrašnje izazove, prebrode prošlost i pronađu mir. Frizeri, šminkeri i stilisti brižljivo oblikuju izgled, naglašavajući individualnu lepotu i autentičnost svake žene. Svaka transformacija je poput čuda koje se odigrava pred našim očima. U serijalu „Trenutak iz sna, ove izuzetne žene donose hrabru odluku da se odvoje od svojih najbližih dok traje njihova transformacija. A onda, kao najlepša nagrada za hrabrost koju su pokazale, na samom velikom finalu čeka ih porodica koja ih nakon nekoliko nedelja po prvi put vidi u potpuno novom izdanju. Trenutak kada se ponovno sretnu sa svojim voljenima je pravi trenutak iz sna, jer je obasjan osmesima, suzama radosnicama, neprocenjivim zagrljajima i nevericom.Ovaj serijal nije samo priča o transformaciji, već i o ljubavi, hrabrosti, podršci i ljudskosti koju dugujemo jedni drugima. „Trenutak iz sna je prilika da kroz svaku epizodu proživite emotivno putovanje, zato ne propustite novu sezonu, svakog četvrtka u 22 časa na televiziji Pink.

programme.title: Trenutak iz sna
programme.desc: Nova sezona „Trenutak iz sna donosi priče žena čiji fizički izgled svedoči o decenijama stresa, tuge, teškog fizičkog rada i trauma. Njihov fizički izgled odražava godine skrivanja od pogleda drugih iz straha da ne budu osuđene, a svaki pogled u ogledalo ih podseća na njihove unutrašnje borbe, svaki susret sa ljudima ih suočava sa osećajem srama i odbačenosti. Kroz suze, bol i odlučnost pronašle su put ka svetlu. Njihove priče su izuzetne, njihova hrabrost nadmašuje granice mogućeg, a njihova transformacija je inspiracija za sve. Tim vrhunskih stručnjaka učiniće sve da ove žene podignu iz pepela, obnove njihovu veru u sebe i pronađu unutrašnju snagu. Hirurzi i anti-aging eksperti kombinovali su svoje svoje veštine kako bi obnovili, pomladili kožu i uklonili mnoge fizičke nedostatke, pomažući ženama da povrate svežinu i vitalnost. Stomatolozi stvaraju blistav osmeh koji zrači samopouzdanjem i zdravljem. Psiholozi pružaju emocionalnu podršku i pomažu ženama da prevaziđu unutrašnje izazove, prebrode prošlost i pronađu mir. Frizeri, šminkeri i stilisti brižljivo oblikuju izgled, naglašavajući individualnu lepotu i autentičnost svake žene. Svaka transformacija je poput čuda koje se odigrava pred našim očima. U serijalu „Trenutak iz sna, ove izuzetne žene donose hrabru odluku da se odvoje od svojih najbližih dok traje njihova transformacija. programme.title: Kuća od srca
programme.desc: Iz kreativne kuhinje produkcijske kuće "Shadow production" dolazi nova sezona najhumanijeg TV serijala "Kuća od srca". Najdramatičnija sezona do sada donosi snažne priče o ljudima koji su se našli na ivici egzistencije. Oni nemaju dom kakav zaslužuju, a zbog neadekvatnih uslova koji prete da ugroze živote i zdravlje porodice, najviše ispaštaju deca. Usled susreta sa surovim udarcima života deca mogu da izgube pravo na svoje detinjstvo. Urušeni plafoni i zidovi puni vlage svedoče o tome da su ove porodice za dlaku izbegle smrt. Njihove sudbine su neizvesne, a potresne ispovesti ostaviće gledaoce bez daha.

programme.title: Šifra Despot
programme.desc: "Šifra Despot" je elegična socijalna komedija naravi i mentaliteta, smeštena u ambijent metropole, ali podjednako i u autentična srpska predgrađa, varošice, gradove, sela i zaseoke. Ne napuštajući ni jednog trenutka životne vratolomije glavnog junaka serije, pomalo nespretnog i taličnog, ali veoma talentovanog kompjuterskog programera Despota Despotovića, kog igra mladi glumac Đorđe Marković, serija će u tematskom, vizuelnom i socijalnom smislu oslikati vreme u kom živimo. Nastojanje glavnog lika da preživi i da obezbedi sopstvenu egzistenciju kao jedini zaposleni u svojoj softverskoj kući "Despot & Co", u svakoj od 45 epizoda prve sezone, vodiće njega i gledaoce serije na najrazličitije lokacije i socijalne sredine - na farmu ćuraka, u fitnis centar, bolnice, fabrike, advokatske kancelarije, u nevladine organizacije, političke partije, staračke domove, sportske klubove, kladionice, banke, škole plesa, modne salone i mnoga druga mesta - što predstavlja izvanredan dramaturški i scenaristički okvir za razvoj komediografskih odnosa, kojim će pored društveno odgovorih tema, koje će serija tretirati, gledaoci biti u prilici da se zabave, relaksiraju uz zdrav i nepatvoreni humor na temljima srpskog mentaliteta - koji autor Radoš Bajić izvanredno dobro poznaje.

programme.title: Oteta, serija
programme.desc: Priča o Orhunu, koji želi da osveti svoju sestru, i Hiri, koja je zarobljenica svoje savesti... Orhun je uspešan biznismen koji je odrastao u bogatoj porodici bez ljubavi zajedno sa svojom sestrom bliznakinjom Nihan, mlađom sestrom Nursah i njihovom hladnom, udaljenom majkom Afife. Nihan je otišla da volonterski radi kao lekar u Eritreji, ali je odnedavno bilo nemoguće kontaktirati, a njena porodica je zabrinuta za nju. Dok traži svoju sestru, nailazi na Hiru, siromašnu devojku koja živi kao zatvorenik u rukama trgovaca ljudima. Kada saznaju da je Nihan otrovala i ubila lokalna banda, Orhun se slomi. Kada se ispostavi da je Hira zapravo bila ta koja je otrovala njegovu sestru, Orhun kuje zli plan osvete: povest će Hiru kući sa sobom i učiniti joj još gore. U međuvremenu, Afife, njihova majka, tajno je držala Orhunovog oca podalje od njegovog detinjstva. Orhun odlučuje da se oženi Hirom iz osvete. Afife mrzi ljude nižeg statusa i opsednuta je "čistom krvlju". Hoće li ovaj brak zatvoriti Afife, ili će par pronaći iskupljenje nakon što plati sve svoje obaveze?

programme.title: Novo jutro
programme.desc: Milionski auditorijum navikao je da dan započinje upravo jutarnjim programom TV Pink. Svakog dana građani Srbije dobijaju sve pravovremene i objektivne informacije od uigranog voditeljskog para. Osim najaktuelnijih vesti iz zemlje i sveta, u jutarnjem programu "Novo jutro" gledaoce očekuju dobro poznate rubrike - "Saveti lekara", "Prelistavanje dnevne štampe", "Tema jutra", "Saveti advokata" i "Razgibavanje". Jutarnji program osvežen je i novim rubrikama - "(Ne)zapaženo" koja se bavi društvenim temama o kojima se priča ili pak onima koje zavređuju više naše pažnje. Rubrika "Pod reflektorima" posvećena je glumcima a "Hit jutra", gostovanju pevača najnovijih izdanja. "Novo jutro" donosi i uključenja iz gradova širom Srbije - Niša, Novog Sada, Kraljeva, Čačka, Zaječara, Valjeva i naravno Beograda - kroz koja će gledaoci dobiti sve važne servisne informacije za ostatak dana. Novitet u jutarnjem programu "Novo jutro" je i lutajući reporter, Filip Maksimović, kog je publika već imala priliku da upozna kroz vrlo karakteristična uključenja sa terena.

programme.title: Nasledstvo
programme.desc: Dve žene koje se nikada u životu nisu srele otrovane su istim otrovom, istoga dana. Jedna je devedesetogodišnja vlasnica predratnog hotela Pariz u kojem je vreme stalo, a druga je sekretarica tajkuna koji pokušava da se domogne hotela u centru grada, kako bi na njegovom mestu izgradio najveći tržni centar na Balkanu. Ko je ubica dve žene, a ko neverovatni naslednik hotela i celokupne imovine ubijene vlasnice? U mnogobrojnim obrtima, u vrtlogu para i ljubavi, odanosti i izdaje, iskrenosti i podlosti, sveta siromašnih i sveta bogatih, poštenja i lopovluka, časti i pohlepe, skromnosti i snobovštine, sukoba generacija, porodičnih lomova i društvenih previranja - lome se i sudbine čak i onih koji u tome nisu želeli da učestvuju.

programme.title: Premijera
programme.desc: Aktuelno, premijerno, za korak ispred svih - Premijera je zbog toga najgledanija kratka forma vesti o poznatima. Ne postoji javna ličnost do koje premijerna ekipa ne može doći, a nijedan gradski događaj ne može proći bez njih. I u novoj sezoni najveće domaće i regionalne zvezde govoriće pred Premijerinim kamerama, ali kroz nove rubrike: Ličnost dana, VIP online, Sa beogradskih ulica i Ispred premijernog objektiva.

programme.title: Kad na vrbi rodi grožđe, serija
programme.desc: Serija se po malo, a nekada i malo više, podsmeva bahatostima, mitomaniji, primitvluku, glupostima i besmislicama na koje, naši junaci svoga mentaliteta radi, najčešće, život utrošiše...Ova serija govori o naravima građana malog mesta, negde na Balkanu. Oni se međusobno prepiru, nekada i posvade, često zavole, a i razilaze...ali su jedni na druge upućeni, i jedni bez drugih ne mogu. Postoje trenuci kada je nekome od njih teško, kada se desi prirodno zlo, često radost, a i žalost, oni se okupljaju jedni oko drugih, pomažu, tu su da se nađu i da učine što mogu. Oni su komšije, bez obzira na ime, veru i naciju...

programme.title: Villa Maria, serija
programme.desc: Porodici Jurak nacionalizovan je veći deo imovine nakon Drugog svetskog rata, ali svejedno nisu ostali siromašni. Stanuju u dobrom zagrebačkom kvartu. Tomislav Jurak (Žarko Radić) je pedesetogodišnjak, vodi porodični biznis koji uključuje lanac restorana i hotel u centru grada, koji je počeo da gradi još u vreme socijalizma, ali ga je u vlasništvo preuzeo tokom privatizacije devedesetih novcem svoje tete Mitzy. Njegova žena Ana Jurak (Ksenija Pajić), u ranim četrdesetim, rodila mu je dvoje dece- Ivana i Doru. Ana je napustila studije prava kad ga je upoznala i posvetila se brizi o porodici i uz pomoć kućne pomoćnice, brizi o samoj sebi-shopping, bazen i tračanje, omiljene su joj obaveze. Kako god bilo, ona je u svakom slučaju temelj familije. Ćerka Dora (Jelena Veljača) ima 20 godina i studira ekonomiju. Otac je obožava i ne prihvata činjenicu da je već odavno došla u godine da ima dečka i svoju intimu. Razmažena tatina kćer. Ivan (Mislav Čavajda) radi s ocem u firmi. Zgodan zagrebački dečko, dvadesetpetogodišnjak, ali neodgovoran, sklon porocima, ukratko, loš karakter lepog lica. S druge strane, nalazi se porodica bankara Maksa Lovreka (Ante Čedo Martinić), koji Jurakovoj firmi daje veliki kredit za preuzimanje malotrgovinskog lanca. On i Tomislav Jurak (ne)prijatelji su još od falultetskih dana. Uz posao, Jurakovi i Lovrekovi povezani su i privatno, a razdoblje prividnog prijateljstva s početka priče ubrzo prerasta u suparništvo. Max Lovrek oženjen je Vesnom Lovrek (Barbara Vicković), ženom sumnjivog karaktera, koja je pritom Maksu neverna. Bankar Lovrek iz prvog braka ima sina Svena (Sven Madžarević), 2o godišnjaka, prilično povučenog, skromnog dečka. Maks kuje zaveru protiv Juraka s Jurakovim ambicioznim sinom Ivanom. Treća glavna ekipa su bolesna majka Dunja (Nada Gačešić Livaković) i njen sin Luka (Damir Markovina), pametan i obrazovan mladić koji neumorno radi kod Jurakovih, ali ne razume da ga oni iskorištavaju. Ima i razloga za slepilo: voli Jurakovu ćerku, Doru. Njihovu vezu Tomislav Jurak nikad ne bi dopustio...

programme.title: Crveni mesec, serija
programme.desc: Ljubavna, ali i snažna istorijska priča, smeštena je u period od avgusta 1913, nakon pobede Srbije u Balkanskim ratovima kada je povratila deo teoritorije, do kraja 1915. godine, kada je austrougarska vojska okupirala Beograd. Glavni junak, mladi srpski oficir koga tumači Miloš Đurović, vraća se sa ratišta u rodnu kuću. Svadba mu je, tradicionalno, već zakazana, ali zaplet priče počinje kada se ćerka austrougarskog poslanika, koju igra Ivana Dudić, zainteresuje za njega. Nedopustivo za to vreme, koketna mlada dama, ne krije svoja osećanja prema mladom oficiru. Rasplet njihove ljubavne drame,koja je plod mašte autora, odvija se u realnom istorijskom periodu pred Veliki rat, pa se u scenariju pojavljuje još dvadesetak glavnih likova, uglavnom stvarnih istorijskih ličnosti. Ovo ostvarenje obiluje dramatičnim događajima, špijunskim intrigama, diplomatskim nadmudrivanjima, političkim spletkama i prevarama...

This series will offer you a complete Croatian experience. Watch it now on Nautical Channel.​

programme.title: 52 Super Series
programme.desc: 2026 - - 52 Super Series Sailing Week Established as the world’s leading grand prix for monohull yacht, the 52 Super Series is a yacht racing circuit like no other. The circuit grew from the ashes of the TP52 MedCup that finished in 2011 in an initiative by three key stakeholders who enjoyed this race so much they wanted to keep it alive.The 52 Super Series embraces like-minded individuals and crews in venues and locations enjoyed by all. This is a series for the best. From Olympic medallists to America’s Cup victors, the dockside is filled with talent.Watch the racing circuit as yachts speed well over 20 knots and representing sailors from over 20 different nationalities in this sustainable event. Competitors race on a simple first-past-the-post format, so real time racing is all that matters, as there is no post-race time compensation.Find out what makes the 52 Super Series the best monohull racing in the world.

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup, 2018 - Sprint 2 World Cup Duisburg
programme.desc: Welcome to Duisburg in Germany! The World Cup 2 of the 2018 season is being disputed, and athletes from all over the world are pitching themselves in one of the most beautiful settings we have on the circuit. Kayaks, canoes, singles, doubles and fours... all are fighting to go to the Olympic Games in Tokyo in two years time. Let's see where they are at the moment! Discover the best action of the weekend's regatta in Duisburg.

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup, 2018 - Sprint 3 World Cup Montemor
programme.desc: In this third stage of the competition we are in Montemor-o-Velho, in Portugal. This is the 2018 ICF Sprint World Championships, where 676 athletes from 66 nations are ready to give everything they have and raise with the title. The weather is perfect and the organization is perfect. Will the athletes be up to standards in this awaited event? Let's look back at the best of the action over the past four days of competition.

programme.title: H2O Racing: F1H2O World Championship, 2025 - - GP of Indonesia
programme.desc: After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM F1H2O World Championship is the flagship series of international single-seater inshore circuit Formula powerboat racing. It attracts up to 20 of the world’s leading drivers from 13 countries who navigate the lightweight, tunnel-hull catamarans reaching speeds in excess of 240km/h on the straights.Watch them race through the water in an epic H20 Racing: F1H20 World Championship that has nothing to envy from land F1, on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: H2O Racing: Aquabike World Championship
programme.desc: 2023 - GP Lake of Toba - Ski division GP1 and Ski Ladies After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM-ABP H20 Racing Aquabike World Championship is the premier international Jet Ski competition that sees elite riders compete on cutting edge equipment in four categories: Runabout, Ski, Ski Ladies and Freestyle. The need for speed is demonstrated on this extreme water sport as athletes plough across the water.

programme.title: Speed Catamarans GC32
programme.desc: After making their debut in indomitable style in 2014, the unique flying catamarans literally "took off" on their first European Circuit in 2015. Building on the success of the America's Cup foiling catamarans, the GC32 takes the thrill of foiling to an extraordinary performance level in a fiercely fought five stage circuit raced across five iconic venues in Italy, Spain and France.

programme.title: The South To Sian Journals
programme.desc: While filming South To Sian, a pair of adventurers dived into what began as a three-month trip and turned into a two-year odyssey of exploration.On boards, bikes, by boat and four-wheel drive, Harrison Roach and Zye Norris discovered if, in these days of GPS and WiFi, the dream of a true pioneering surf adventure is still alive.South to Sian Journals is a collection of stories documenting the people, places & adventures that occurred during the 2 years making South To Sian - the challenges, the surfers, riders, shapers, bike builders, filmmakers and photographers.Extremely entertaining and insightful, Journals documents the travels, the hardships, the spectacular locations, the personalities and the thoughts of the characters, both in front of and behind the lens.

programme.title: Qatar Airways GKA Kite World Tour Magazines, 2023
Kitesurf Odyssey 2017, 2017 - 2017
programme.desc: The Azores KiteSurf Odyssey is the biggest and ultimate journey of Francisco Lufinha, a 34 year-old Portuguese entrepreneur and a nautical sports addicted. The goal is to connect the entire Portuguese territory Kitesurfing from the Azores to the mainland, more than 1500 km of Atlantic Ocean in its most savage state.His journey takes us on an adventure to discover more about kitesurfing and the connection of Francisco with the ocean. As he depends on wind currents, he will have to tack and change routes constantly in order to arrive to his destination. An inspiring story of self determination and challenge, follow Francisco Lufinha to the mainland on Kitesurf Odyssey.

programme.title: Ljubi, ljubi, al glavu ne gubi, film
programme.desc: Dok Marija i Boba, nastavljajući svoju ljubav, provode ljeto na omladinskoj radnoj akciji, njihove roditelje zahvataju "lude godine" i "seksualna revolucija". Vrhunac nastaje kada se u život tate Žike, Bobinog oca, poslije kratkog flerta sa Marijinom majkom, umiješaju dvije mlade Njemice. Doznavši za to, Marija i Boba nastoje da urazume svoje "zabludjele" roditelje i da ih vrate na pravo mjesto. Urnebesna komedija, nastavak filmova "Lude godine" i "Došlo doba da se ljubav proba".

programme.title: Halo taksi, film
programme.desc: Na jednoj taksi stanici na periferiji grada život teče normalno do trenutka kad se pojavi novi taksist - lijepa djevojka. Taksist i bivši bokser, sumnja da ga žena vara. Uhvativši je na djelu, obračuna se sa njenim ljubavnikom Bizmarkom. Nakon toga žena ga napusti, te biva pretučen i odluči istjera svoju pravdu. Istovremeno se i policija zainteresira za Bizmarka. Naime, sve djevojke iz njegovog društva su narkomanke i sve tajanstveno nestaju. U završni rasplet događaja umiješani su taksisti, predvođeni svojom lijepom kolegicom, Interpol i policija...

programme.title: Razvod na određeno vrijeme, film
programme.desc: Problemi suvremenog života jedne obitelji iskazani na komičan način kroz bračne zgode i nezgode, ljubavne nesporazume, razvod zbog stana, avanture na ljetovanju.

programme.title: Čuvar plaže u zimskom periodu, film
programme.desc: Odrastao u atmosferi promašenog braka svojih roditelja, mladić želi da pođe svojim putem u život. Škola koju je završio ne pruža mu šanse da se zaposli, pa zato prihvati mjesto čuvara plaže u zimskom periodu. Oženi se djevojkom koju voli, vjerujući da ljubav može da prebrodi sve teškoće. Ubrzo uvidi da su i njegovi roditelji jednom poletno počeli, ali da su taj polet ugušile životne nedaće. Žena ga napusti, otac mu umire i mladić se našao pred novim početkom, ali sada opterećen gorčinom.

programme.title: Beogradski fantom, film
programme.desc: „Beogradski fantom snimljen je po istinitom događaju iz 1979. Te godine, u Beogradu, mladić po imenu Vlada Vasiljević ukrao je bijeli „Porsche 911 S Targa" i deset noći uzastopno izluđivao policiju noćnim vožnjama. Bezuspješni pokušaji pripadnika policije da bijeli „Porsche" zaustave „Zastavama" 1300 i 101 okupljali su na Slaviji svake noći sve brojniju publiku, čije simpatije su nepodjeljeno bile na strani beogradskog fantoma, kako je narod prozvao misterioznog vozača. U to vrijeme „beogradski fantom postao je svojevrsni simbol otpora jugoslavenskom sistemu i zbog toga je stekao veliku popularnost među građanima. Vlada Vasiljević, kad su ga uhvatili, odležao je u zatvoru dvije godine, a kasnije je smrtno stradao u prometnoj nesreći pod nerazjašnjenim okolnostima. Film je snimljen 30 godina nakon stvarnih događaja, a među njegove najveće kvalitete svakako spada uravnoteženost dokumentarnih i igranih djelova, kompjuterski efekti kojima je rekonstruiran nekadašnji izgled trga Slavija, uzbudljive scene automobilskih potjera te efektna glazba. Riječ je o diplomskom filmu redatelja Jovana Todorovića.

programme.title: Lepota poroka, film
programme.desc: Negdje visoko u crnogorskim brdima još uvijek vlada zakon "časti i krvi" koji među ostalim nalaže da ukoliko žena prevari muža, muž je treba ubiti maljem. Mladi bračni par Jaglika i Luka, vidjevši da njihov kum Žorž odlično zarađuje dolje u primorju, odluči okušati sreću. Žorž radi u naturističkom odmaralištu u kojem zaposli Jagliku kao sobaricu dok Luki pronađe posao u solani. U početku Jaglika je zgranuta golotinjom no ubrzo joj postane zanimljivo proučavati mladi bračni par kojem je sobarica. Vidjevši da ih rado promatra, a zaintrigirani Jaglikinom sramežljivošću, mladi par Engleza pokušava joj prići. Jaglikin pogled na odnos muškarca i žene mijenja se otkrivanjem novog svijeta, kao i Lukin, ali u suprotnom smjeru... Izvrstan film, "Lepota poroka" (1986), crnogorskog redatelja Živka Nikolića bavi se sudarom civilizacija i običaja, one crnogorske arhaične, koja živi negdje na kamenjaru i one primorske koja je uslijed vala turizma zauzela potpuno suprotne stavove. Nikolić je žestok i duhovit u prikazu ruralne zaostalosti koja mu daje dovoljno potke da izgradi jednu od najgledanijih komedija na ovim prostorima. Izvrsna glumačka ekipa u kojoj posebno briljiraju Mira Furlan u ulozi Jaglike za koju je osvojila Zlatnu arenu na Pulskom festivalu te Petar Božović u ulozi kuma, okuplja i manje poznata imena te tako u ulozi mladog engleskog para gledamo Ines Kotman, lijepu manekenku koja je ovom jedinom filmskom ulogom postala ikona 80-ih te francuskog glumca Alaina Nouryja (Histoire d'O, Sezona mira u Parizu). U ostalim ulogama imamo prilike gledati i nasmijati se uvijek izvrsnoj komičarki Miri Banjac te Evi Ras (Ljubavni slučaj ili tragedija službenice PTT) koja u ovom filmu u ulozi Žorževe žene jedina ima dramatičnu ulogu.

programme.title: Ljubi, ljubi, al glavu ne gubi, film
programme.desc: Dok Marija i Boba, nastavljajući svoju ljubav, provode ljeto na omladinskoj radnoj akciji, njihove roditelje zahvataju "lude godine" i "seksualna revolucija". Vrhunac nastaje kada se u život tate Žike, Bobinog oca, poslije kratkog flerta sa Marijinom majkom, umiješaju dvije mlade Njemice. Doznavši za to, Marija i Boba nastoje da urazume svoje "zabludjele" roditelje i da ih vrate na pravo mjesto. Urnebesna komedija, nastavak filmova "Lude godine" i "Došlo doba da se ljubav proba".

programme.title: Halo taksi, film
programme.desc: Na jednoj taksi stanici na periferiji grada život teče normalno do trenutka kad se pojavi novi taksist - lijepa djevojka. Taksist i bivši bokser, sumnja da ga žena vara. Uhvativši je na djelu, obračuna se sa njenim ljubavnikom Bizmarkom. Nakon toga žena ga napusti, te biva pretučen i odluči istjera svoju pravdu. Istovremeno se i policija zainteresira za Bizmarka. Naime, sve djevojke iz njegovog društva su narkomanke i sve tajanstveno nestaju. U završni rasplet događaja umiješani su taksisti, predvođeni svojom lijepom kolegicom, Interpol i policija...

programme.title: Razvod na određeno vrijeme, film
programme.desc: Problemi suvremenog života jedne obitelji iskazani na komičan način kroz bračne zgode i nezgode, ljubavne nesporazume, razvod zbog stana, avanture na ljetovanju.

programme.title: Bure baruta, film
programme.desc: Predstavljen u svijetu kao 'Cabaret Balkan', Paskaljevićev film brutalni je kolaž priča koji se odvija tijekom jedne noći u Beogradu kada dvadesetak protagonista, povezanih besmislenim nasiljem koje se leptirovim efektom širi kao nezaustavljivo prokletstvo, pokušava ispuniti najteži zadatak od svih: preživjeti. Brojni likovi isprepliću svoje putove u noći prije potpisivanja Daytonskog sporazuma, a glavni je junak zapravo Osveta, koja ne dozvoljava iskupljenje čak niti onima koji posjeduju zrno dobra. U sjećanju ostaju taksist i njegov putnik, autobus pun talaca, nesretna žena u vlaku, ali i niz drugih potresnih priča koje se, jedna po jedna, stravičnom logikom, povezuju u tragičnu cjelinu balkanskog ludila. Film renomiranog Gorana Paskaljevića ('Varljivo leto '68', 'Čuvar plaže u zimskom periodu') osvojio je mnoge nagrade, od kojih je najuglednija ona na venecijanskom festivalu, za najbolji film 1998. Scenarij je napisao Dejan Dukovski prema vlastitoj drami, a glavna je tema istraživanje porijekla nasilja, naizgled rođenog iz beznačajnih, svakodnevnih situacija. Paskaljevićev film napučen je brojnim poznatim glumačkim imenima, u velikoj mjeri zaslužnih za uspješno pretakanje drame Dejana Dukovskog na filmsku vrpcu.

programme.title: Groznica ljubavi, film
programme.desc: Mladić i djevojka se strašno vole, ali kad ona zatrudni situacija postaje dramatična. Djevojka iz zdravstvenih razloga ne smije abortirati, a njena majka ima veoma ambiciozne planove. Majka je skriva do poroda, a preko ovjetnika stupa u kontakt s njemačkim bračnim parom koji želi "kupiti" bebu. Djevojka, razočarana, pristaje na ovo rješenje. Nakon što mladić pronađe djevojku i sazna da je postao otac, odlučuje oteti i sakriti dijete.

programme.title: Maratonci trče počasni krug, film
programme.desc: Crnohumorna komedija. Šest mjeseci nakon atentata na kralja Aleksandra 1934. Obitelj Topalović već naraštajima vodi radionicu mrtvačkih sanduka "Dugo konačište". Nakon pradjeda Maksimilijana (M. Tomić), djeda Aksentija (M. Aleksić), oca Milutina (P. Vujisić) i sina Lakija (D. Stojković), najmlađi Topalović, unuk Mirko (B. Diklić), ne želi nastaviti posao. Mirkova odluka stigne u najgori trenutak, jer je obitelj upravo ostala bez najstarijeg člana, osnivača radionice Pantelije Topalovića (R. Lazarević). Mirko se s djevojkom Kristinom (S. Sablić) i prijateljem Đenkom (B. Todorović) oduševljava filmovima i sebe vidi kao filmaša, a ne kao pogrebnika. U međuvremenu, Topalovići će zaratiti s Kristininim ocem Bilijem Pitonom (Z. Radmilović) prekinuvši s njim posao krađe mrtvačkih sanduka na mjesnom groblju... "Samo je smrt siguran posao", čuje se u jednoj od najboljih komedija srbijanske kinematografije, crnohumornom filmu "Maratonci trče počasni krug" (1982) redatelja Slobodana Šijana (Tko to tamo pjeva, Davitelj protiv davitelja). Nastao prema tekstu dramatičara Dušana Kovačevića, film je urbebesan spoj burleske o pet naraštaja pogrebničke obitelji Topalović i kriminalističke potke o najmlađem članu obitelji koji od naivnog zanesenjaka postaje hladnokrvni ubojica. Kovačevićev je tekst osim maestralnog prenošenja na veliko platno doživio i niz kazališnih izvedbi, dok je film ubrzo stekao kultni status u bivšoj Jugoslaviji u čijim je kinima privukao i brojnu publiku. Tajna je uspjeha filma u sjajnim dijalozima, plastičnim likovima i bizarnom zapletu pri čemu se dosljedno ismijava kultura smrti i lažnog morala. Šijan i Kovačević, uz to, vrlo duhovito progovaraju o srbijanskom društvu tridesetih kada njegovu okamenjenu tradiciju počinju nagrizati modernizacija i emancipacija (spretno poigravanje zvučnim filmom i krematorijem). Taj je motiv starog i novog, vremešnog i mladog, okarakteriziran kroz pet naraštaja obitelji Topalović čiji su interpreti redom ostvarili uloge svoje karijere: Milivoje Tomić, Mija Aleksić, Pavle Vujisić, Danilo Stojković i Bogdan Diklić. Potonji tumači najmlađeg člana Mirka čiji će karakterni obrat galvanizirati cijelu radnju dajući filmu pečat neprolazne crne komedije. Glazba Zorana Simjanovića i kamera Božidara Nikolića upotpunjuju dojam o filmu, dok od ostalih glumačkih imena treba istaknuti pokojnog Zorana Radmilovića u ulozi Bilija Pitona kao parafraze čikaških gangstera dvadesetih i tridesetih, te Jelisavetu Sablić kao Mirkovu nevjernu djevojku Kristinu. Kritičari smatraju da je to svevremenski portret balkanskog tipa malograđanštine i kriminala. Šijanova je komedija i u zemlji i u inozemstvu dobila niz nagrada, među ostalima, i pulsku Zlatnu arenu za ulogu Jelisavete Sablić, te nagradu na međunarodnom filmskom festivalu u Montrealu.

programme.title: Poltron, film
programme.desc: Film "Poltron" je komedija o odnosu poltrona (ulizice) i generalnog direktora u tipičnom jugoslavenskom poduzeću u kojem vlada nerad, jal i neodgovornost... U jednom tipično jugoslavenskom poduzeću razvija se odnos poltrona (ulizice) i generalnog direktora. U atmosferi nerada, jala i neodgovornosti, kroz ovaj odnos otkrivaju se razni negativni mehanizmi koji karakteriziraju stvarnost. U pozadini glavnog tijeka priče otkriva se i privatni život ovih likova koji nije ništa veseliji od onog na poslu.

programme.title: Paradox Live: Rolf Delfos, Modern
programme.desc: Innovative contemporary jazz and improvised music, the search for modernity, mind blowing sounds, rock and pop… Indeed PARADOX Tilburg goes beyond jazz, crossing musical boundaries into the unknown soundscapes of electronic music. Indie artists, blues veterans and jazz superstars all pour their hearts and souls at the Paradox. From young, local talents to top national and international artists, PARADOX Tilburg is the most intimate jazz club in the Netherlands, with a devoted audience from all across Europe. In their TV show PARADOX LIVE you get a taste of the greatest concerts and interviews with artists from all around the world. This episode of PARADOX LIVE presents the amazing Dutch saxophone player Rolf Delfos.

programme.title: Stan Getz Quintet - The North Sea Jazz, Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. Legendary American saxophonist Stan Getz gave an unforgettable performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague in 1980. Getz, one of the leading jazz musicians of his generation, was known for his warm, lyrical tone. Inspired by the music of Antônio Carlos Jobim, Getz helped popularize bossa nova in the United States.

programme.title: The Morgenland Festival: VIVA! Fusion
programme.desc: Since 2005, the Morgenland Festival of Osnabrueck has dedicated itself to the fascinating music culture of the Near and Middle East. From traditional and classical music to avant-garde, jazz, and rock, the festival program also features art, such as visual arts, dance, and theatre of interdisciplinary projects. Viva is a perfect mixture of various instruments and musicians from all over the world. Vocalists Aynur and Dima Oshno perform with the All Star Band. Aynur sings about the life and sufferings of Kurdish people, in particular Kurdish women. Musically, she tries to blend Kurdish and Western music, creating her own style and interpreting the traditional repertoire in a modern and fresh way.

programme.title: Lex Jasper Trio: Happy Days Are Here Again, Modern
programme.desc: Lex Jasper Trio: Happy Days Are Here Again - the title says is all… After an automobile accident and 15 years of revalidation, he is back! Together with his musical pals Edwin Corzilius (double bass) and Frits Landesbergen (drums), pianist and composer Lex Jasper celebrates his return to jazz club The Duke in the Dutch village of Nistelrode. Following his car accident, Lex nearly joined the leagues of Netherland's forgotten jazz heroes, though he is still considered one of the most important artists and composers of his generation and Dutch jazz history. Jasper played and recorded with all the greats, including Toots Thielemans, Clark Terry, Joe Pass, and Rita Reys.

programme.title: Thomas Carbou: Spectacle Au Bleury, Fusion
programme.desc: Thomas Carbou and Patrick Graham share an almost telepathic rapport, blending spontaneous improvisation, electronic looping, and Brazilian and Indian musical influences to create ecstatic groove pieces and dream-like soundscapes. They use a wide array of instruments, including a custom-built 8-string guitar, cuatro, bouzouki, cajón, frame drums, berimbau, udu, and metal percussion instruments, as well as samplers and laptops, adding their own hypnotic vocals to the mix. This concert was recorded at Montréal’s Le Bleury Vinyl Bar, near the Place des Festivals, known worldwide as the venue for the Montreal International Jazz Festival.

programme.title: Michel Camilo Trio - Münchner Klaviersommer, Jazz
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music - not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1994, Dominican Republic pianist Michel Camilo was one of the artists appearing here. Camilo performed with Michael Bowie on bass and Cliff Almond on drums. Their music incorporates influences that range from Art Tatum and Keith Jarrett's jazz to the twentieth-century classical music of Debussy and Ravel.

programme.title: Ray Charles live at North Sea Jazz, Soul
programme.desc: The world-renowned North Sea Jazz Festival features a wide variety of genres, including traditional New Orleans jazz, swing, bop, free jazz, fusion, avant-garde and electronic jazz, blues, gospel, funk, soul, R&B, hip hop, world beat and Latin. The festival was founded by entrepreneur and jazz fan Paul Acket, who sold his highly successful pop magazine publishing house to organize and fund the first edition of the festival in 1976. This broadcast from the North Sea Jazz Archives presents a compilation with music of Ray Charles.

programme.title: Forest GIIPUJA, World
programme.desc: GIIPUJA has been bringing modern jazz with a distinct ethnic flavor to Croatian audiences since 2013. The unusual line-up of double bass, drums, bass clarinet, violin, and various folkloristic instruments from the Istria region, makes for a strikingly original and unique sound. At times, GIIPUJA embraces harsh dissonance, fueled by the interplay of narrow intervals characteristic for the Istrian scale, whilst at other times it uses those same compositional and improvisational principles to create a jubilant atmosphere. This beautiful performance of their project ‘Forest GIIPUJA’ was recorded at Croatia’s Učka Nature Park in 2016. GIIPUJA consists of Damjan Grbac (double bass), Marko First (violin, sopela, mih), Aldo Foško (bass clarinet), and Tonči Grabušić (drums).

programme.title: Portrait of Maria Ana Bobone, Concert
programme.desc: Maria Ana Bobone (Portugal) is one of the best fado singers of her generation. She started singing fado when she was 16. Her debut album is called ‘Alma Nova’ and marked the beginning of her amazing career. For the recordings of her next two albums, ‘Luz Destino’ and ‘Senhora da Lapa’ Maria Ana welcomed instruments that are usually not present in fado music: the harpsichord and saxophone. After that, she continued her career with the release of ‘Nome de Mar’, which received many positive reviews. At the moment, Maria Ana is performing at all Portugal’s major venues, as well as many festivals and concert halls throughout the world, with the aim to present fado music and Portuguese culture to other cultures. Bobone’s latest album, ‘Fado & Piano’, shows her diversity as an artist, composer and arranger. By including the piano she re-innovates the tradition of the early 20th century. This portrait shows Maria Ana’s performances and interviews in which she explains her passion for fado music and culture.

programme.title: In pursuit of the 27th man, Concert
programme.desc: Legendary jazz pianist Horace Silver's groundbreaking fusion of hard bop, blues, soulful grooves and Cape Verdean influences have left an indelible mark on the world of jazz. At the renowned Umbria Jazz Festival in the picturesque region of Umbria, Italy, Silver is accompanied by a great band of future all-stars: Bob Berg on tenor sax, Tom Harrell on trumpet, Steve Beskrone on bass and Eddie Gladden on drums. During this performance from July 20, 1976, Silver’s quintet stretches out on four Silver originals: Adjustment, Barbara, In Pursuit of the 27th Man, and Song For My Father. Tune in and let Horace Silver’s irresistible music mesmerize you!

programme.title: Sonny Sharrock - Peanut, Concert
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential jazz guitarists in history showcases these legends’ unique essence. Revel in Wes Montgomery’s virtuosity as he performs the captivating Nica's Dream in Holland in 1965, and delight in the expressive beauty of his rendition of Here's That Rainy Day, recorded in London in that same year. Experience the timeless appeal of Joe Pass's You Stepped Out of a Dream and You Turned The Tables on Me, recorded live in Hanover in 1975. The interplay between Jim Hall and Atilla Zoller borders on the impossible as they perform Extensions in Hanover in 1973. Enjoy Jim Hall's lyrical solo performance of I'm Getting Sentimental Over You from 1964. Witness Sonny Sharrock’s avant-garde fusion of jazz and rock in an exhilarating performance of Peanut", recorded live in France in 1970. Sharrock is joined by flutist Herbie Mann in a soulful performance of Memphis Underground from 1969. Immerse yourself in the magic of jazz guitar!

programme.title: The Hammond© Sessions: Sven Figee, Concert
programme.desc: The Dutch Hammond organ player Rob Mostert develops, in cooperation with DJAZZ, the programme ‘Mostert Meets’. In this series, the Hammond B3 organ takes centre stage. Rob Mostert invites the world’s finest jazz musicians for a musical collaboration, in which the Hammond Organ plays a major role. The Hammond B3 is an electric organ, which generates sound by creating an electric current from rotating a metal tonewheel near an electromagnetic pickup. Initially, the Hammond B3 was at home in churches, until it entered the jazz scene in the mid-20th century. In this episode, Mostert teams up with the Dallas-born vocalist Dede Priest. She’s renowned for her raw sound. She knows how to sing blues and gospel like no other!

programme.title: On The Road With Duke Ellington: II, Jazz
programme.desc: In May 2014, the Conservatory of Amsterdam hosted a unique conference about one of the greatest jazz composers of the 20th century: Duke Ellington. Musicologists and musicians with a special bond with Ellington and his music spoke about his life and music. Among them were David Schiff, author of ‘The Ellington Century’, and Harvey Cohen, author of ‘Duke Ellington’s America’. Moreover, concerts were played by jazz pianist Matt Cooper, the Calefax Reed Quintet, and the Concert Big Band of the Conservatory of Amsterdam conducted by David Berger. The winner of the Boy Edgar Prize 2013, viola player Oene van Geel, performed his ‘All Ellington Project’.

programme.title: Aki Rissanen Trio at Jazzclub Unterfahrt, Munich, Modern
programme.desc: Aki Rissanen's interest in jazz came after he started taking classical piano lessons. His deep interest in improvised music placed him among top jazz pianist in his home country - Finland. While composing and performing his own music, Rissanen has also collaborated with Verneri Pohjola and Dave Liebman, and today his name appears among the top European jazz musicians. Live from 'Jazzclub Unterfahrt' in Munich, Germany, together with Antti Lotjonen on bass and Teppo Makynen on drums, Rissanen showcases the best of Scandinavian jazz and its DNA - the Nordic Tone.
